Thanks Vanessa — quick finance checklist and action items:

1) VAT evidence: we need either a VIES screenshot validating IT12345678901 or an official VAT registration certificate (the attached PDF looks acceptable but please confirm it is the official certificate).
2) Invoice requirements for reverse-charge (EU B2B) — invoices must include:
   - Supplier legal name and VAT ID (as registered)
   - Customer (Redwood Inference) VAT ID (we will provide)
   - A clear statement such as "Reverse charge — Article 44 & 196 of the EU VAT Directive" or "VAT reverse-charged to the recipient"
   - Net amount and VAT shown as 0 with explanation of reverse-charge on the line or footer
3) Banking: beneficiary name must match legal entity on VAT certificate. We also require an IBAN and bank SWIFT for cross-border transfers.
4) Additional docs we typically collect prior to PO activation: company registration excerpt (Chamber of Commerce print), W-8 equivalent is not applicable; supplier declaration of B2B status is fine.

If StellaNova can provide: the VIES validation screenshot, confirmation that invoices will carry the reverse-charge wording above, and bank details (IBAN/SWIFT) we can proceed to raise a PO. Finance SLA: we will review and confirm within 2 business days of receiving those items.

I uploaded our recommended invoice template here: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/stella-invoice-template — Luca, please use this as a guide.

Lauren — if Procurement is happy with the supplier declaration, please advise on PO terms (net days, incoterms N/A for services).

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Finance Manager — Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
attachments: example invoice template link
